proof_scope: sandboxed persistent Python workspace receipts, snapshot restore, admission gating, and replay negatives

claims.proves: Tau can start a Docker-sandboxed persistent Python workspace endpoint, retain namespace state across multiple turns and context compaction, reject stale snapshots and duplicate execution conflicts, deny ambient host/network authority, and read back a completed live proof artifact.
claims.does_not_prove: Herdr-hosted execution parity for issue #315, legal compliance, kernel escape resistance, provider/model quality, or arbitrary package installation.

cases.name: live-docker-python-workspace-issue-317-proof
command: cd .. && mkdir -p artifacts/issue-317-agentic-eval && uv run --project . python scripts/python-workspace-live-proof.py --out artifacts/issue-317-agentic-eval/live-proof.json

cases.name: workspace-contract-negative-regressions
command: cd .. && uv run --project . pytest --tau-suite=all tests/test_sandboxed_python_workspace.py -q -k 'stale_snapshot or duplicate or admission or pinned'

capability_claims.description: Tau can run an optional Docker-sandboxed persistent Python workspace with snapshot restore, admission gating, stale-snapshot rejection, duplicate execution protection, and no ambient host/network authority.
